description: A Bitcoin transaction by txid: confirmed block and time (or unconfirmed), fee in sats and sat/vB, size and virtual size, input and output totals, and whether it signals replace-by-fee. Source: mempool.space. Information only, not financial advice. Related tools on this server, for a different need: btc_fees when you need Recommended Bitcoin fees in sat/vB, the mempool's size; btc_address when you need a Bitcoin mainnet address: confirmed and unconfirmed. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: btc_tx
title: Check a Bitcoin transaction's status, fee and size
